curatorAdjudication.runtimeBoundary: An adjudication packet compares independent local feedback records. It cannot change evidence, authenticate an authorization decision, authorize data access, acquire data, retain data, authorize public deployment, establish biological truth, align reference anatomy, molecular type, morphology, or SCI evidence lanes, create or alter a cross-study identity or morphology join, create or alter an external provenance package, or create a registration. Packet import is read-only and does not certify the original ZIP digest.

curatorFeedback.runtimeBoundary: Local import and local receipt export only; feedback cannot alter evidence, acquire data, authorize a public release, or create a registration.

interneuronKnowledgeCoverage.directCausalBoundary: This direct source experiment is specific to its Vsx2ON definition, injury model, vector and toxin timing, and outcome; it does not establish causality for every source label, a Russ population, or a project entity.

scientificBoundaries.atlasGeometry: The outer-cord and coarse gray-matter row-envelope side surfaces are an inferred display loft (INF) from 15 checksum-locked native atlas contour planes; the old gray-matter envelope is not a full gray boundary. Seven atlas-source-ID internal structures retain 408 separate 4-connected exact mask-edge components/polygons across 15 sampled planes, with dorsal funiculus ID 74 at z1470 explicitly missing. Internal anatomy renders only as plane-local line segments using a seven-color project display-only palette keyed to preserved source IDs; display colors carry no source/anatomical authority, while each exact source color is retained in userData. Internal components are never lofted, filled, joined, manually bridged or cross-plane corresponded. All anatomy is invalid for measurement, has no named spinal segments, and creates 0 REG.
scientificBoundaries.entityGeometry: All seven evidence entities remain synthetic (SYN) and their paths schematic (SCH).
scientificBoundaries.intendedUse: Localhost public-data workbench candidate only; not a validated scientific atlas product.
scientificBoundaries.knowledgeCoverage: The five-source by seven-axis matrix is source-bounded metadata; all cross-study mappings remain not_established, morphology remains not_measured, and missing coverage is not biological absence.
scientificBoundaries.laneSeparation: Reference anatomy, molecular types, source-local morphology, and SCI evidence remain separate coordinate and identity lanes; visual co-display creates no join.
scientificBoundaries.molecularTypes: The 65 Russ non-motoneuron interneuron/projection-neuron candidates remain TYPE_LEVEL and unplaced; they are not 65 confirmed interneurons and have zero exact cross-study identities, zero linked morphologies, and zero project registrations.
scientificBoundaries.morphologyGeometry: Five phenotype-stratified NeuroMorpho exemplars are observed (OBS) only in their source-local frames; they are not representative and are not linked to the seven evidence entities.
scientificBoundaries.registration: There are 0 registrations; every exemplar is unregistered and has no atlas transform or registration error estimate.
scientificBoundaries.scientificInputPolicy: All scientific inputs are public digital sources only; no OHRI internal experimental data, physical specimens or unpublished institutional records are required.
scientificBoundaries.scope: This release is not a complete interneuron census, connectome, clinical model, treatment recommendation, or claim of human cell-type causality.
